# Retail POS 3.0.0-RC3

Retail POS 3.0.0-RC3 focuses on a clearer product-management workflow, faster catalogue imports, and more consistent Retail POS visual styling.

## Highlights

- The products management screen has been redesigned to make catalogue administration clearer and easier to operate.
- Products now expose creation and modification timestamps for better catalogue traceability.
- Fallback product-family imports have been optimized for faster and more efficient catalogue setup.
- Retail POS control theme tokens are aligned more consistently across the application.

## Distribution

This release candidate is distributed as portable x86_64 packages for Linux, Windows, and Intel macOS. Windows and macOS packages include a bundled Java runtime; the Linux package uses the system Java installation. Every package includes a SHA256 checksum.

Native installers, Apple Silicon support, Linux ARM64 support, and platform signing remain planned follow-up work.
